name: Tofu Kingdom
summary: Social deduction game where a rotating Prince questions players to find the secret Princess while roles force truth, lies, or choice.
rules_text: Each round one player is Prince Mochi. Mix character coasters based on player count plus one extra face-down center coaster and deal one hidden role to each non-Prince player. All non-Prince players plus center reveal roles secretly among themselves, memorize, then hide them. Prince opens eyes and asks each other player exactly one of: Where is Princess Tofu? Who are you? Who is he/she? Then he may ask one extra question to one player. Roles dictate answers: Princess and Chef must tell truth, Queen, Minister, Guard must lie, Maid and Spy may lie or tell truth. After questioning Prince chooses a coaster he thinks is Princess or the center. The top-left symbol on chosen coaster is winning symbol: Heart means Prince, Princess and Chef score, Crown means Queen team scores, Mask means Maid and Spy score. Players also score if their bottom-right symbol matches winning symbol. Rotate Prince; play until each player has been Prince 3 times with 3-4 players, 2 times with 5-6, once with 7-8. Most soybeans wins.
rating_reason: Social deduction, hidden roles, bluffing, question answers
